chlavmDescriptionEn: The Hispanic Society of Kamloops shares Hispanic-Latin American heritage through celebrations, educational activities and museum partnerships. Its community programming brings culture into public view and creates opportunities for residents to learn about one another.
chlavmDescriptionEs: La Hispanic Society of Kamloops comparte la herencia hispana y latinoamericana a través de celebraciones, actividades educativas y alianzas con museos. Su programación comunitaria pone la cultura a la vista del público y crea oportunidades para que los residentes se conozcan.
